name: oracle-ai-dev
description: Guided zero-to-app development on Oracle AI Database 26ai Free: setup, converged data modeling (UMT), document/vector/RAG paths, and a measure-driven tuning loop — bundling Oracle SQLcl's MCP server.

sqlcl_path.title: SQLcl executable
sqlcl_path.description: Optional. Path to SQLcl's bin/sql, or 'sql' if it is on PATH. Only the bundled MCP server needs it — leave the default and ask the agent to run scripts/install-sqlcl.sh if you don't have SQLcl; it installs it and prints the path.

tns_admin.title: TNS_ADMIN directory
tns_admin.description: Optional directory containing tnsnames.ora / cloud wallet files.
